scene: You climb atop the tiled roof, overlooking three ready sky transits.
picture: Flat side view. Along a wide rooftop transit platform, a sleek pink bullet train rests with doors open on the far left. The young Chinese woman in her red jacket and skates stands left of centre. A moored solar-sail junk floats at a gangway in the centre. A winding emerald dragon maglev train waits along the far right.
